cues.en: Hey, everybody.
cues.zh: 嗨，各位。

cues.en: I want to take a quick break here.
cues.zh: 我想在這裡稍微休息一下。

cues.en: Go grab a coffee, grab a tea.
cues.zh: 去拿杯咖啡、泡杯茶。

cues.en: Just take a break from all the learning that you just did.
cues.zh: 從剛才學的所有內容中休息一下。

cues.en: And I want to talk to you quickly about imposter syndrome.
cues.zh: 我想簡單談談冒牌者症候群。

cues.en: It's this idea that you're not good enough, that things are too complicated for you to ever achieve what you want to achieve.
cues.zh: 也就是覺得自己不夠好，事情太複雜，永遠無法達成自己想達成的目標。

cues.en: You look at other people, at other industry experts, and you say, I will never get there.
cues.zh: 看著其他人、其他業界專家，心想：「我永遠做不到他們那樣。」

cues.en: But it's just a symptom of learning.
cues.zh: 不過，這只是學習時會出現的一種現象。

cues.en: This idea of you not being good enough simply means that, well, you're just not there yet.
cues.zh: 覺得自己不夠好，其實只是表示你還沒到那個階段。

cues.en: Things take time if you want to learn a valuable skill.
cues.zh: 如果想學會有價值的技能，就需要時間。

cues.en: Well, it's hard work.
cues.zh: 需要下苦功。

cues.en: That's why it's valuable.
cues.zh: 正因如此，它才有價值。

cues.en: Remember how you felt on the first day of going to school?
cues.zh: 記得第一天上學時的感覺嗎？

cues.en: First day on a job?
cues.zh: 或第一天上班？

cues.en: It's the same experience.
cues.zh: 是一樣的經驗。

cues.en: But over time, with repetition, with practice, you get comfortable, you get experience, and you slowly start to lose that imposter syndrome.
cues.zh: 不過隨著時間，透過反覆練習，你會變得自在、累積經驗，慢慢不再覺得自己像冒牌者。

cues.en: Now, this idea of an imposter syndrome is great.
cues.zh: 所以有冒牌者症候群這種感覺，其實很好。

cues.en: It means you're doing something worthwhile, so don't use it as a negative.
cues.zh: 表示你正在做值得的事，別把它當成負面的東西。

cues.en: Use it as an encouragement that you're doing something good, that you're learning and you're stretching your limits.
cues.zh: 把它當成鼓勵，表示你在做有益的事、正在學習，並拓展自己的極限。

cues.en: So with this break, I want to propose that we do a quick exercise.
cues.zh: 趁這次休息，我想提議做個簡短練習。

cues.en: I want you to stop the lectures again, grab a coffee, grab a tea and head on over to our discord.
cues.zh: 再次暫停課程，拿杯咖啡、泡杯茶，前往我們的 Discord。

cues.en: Now in our Discord server, If you've used it up until now, that's great.
cues.zh: 如果你到現在已經用過我們的 Discord 伺服器，很好。

cues.en: If you haven't.
cues.zh: 如果還沒有，

cues.en: Head on over to this server, and I want you to do something that I think is super important to learning, and that is using what you've learned up until now to actually teach someone or help someone.
cues.zh: 就前往伺服器。我希望你做一件對學習非常重要的事，就是把到目前為止學到的內容，實際拿來教別人或幫助別人。

cues.en: So you can go all the way to, let's say, the coding and courses section and pick a topic that you want to help somebody in.
cues.zh: 可以到例如 Coding and Courses 區，選一個想幫助別人的主題。

cues.en: So let's say you go to the Python channel and in here you'll have other students that are asking Python related questions.
cues.zh: 比方說到 Python 頻道，裡面會有其他學生提出 Python 相關問題。

cues.en: Now you can scroll through here and see if you're able to help someone, even though you may not have the experience or the knowledge yet.
cues.zh: 可以往下看看，找找有沒有能幫上忙的地方，即使你可能還沒有足夠的經驗或知識。

cues.en: This idea of practicing and explaining what you've just learned to other people, even if you're not 100% certain, actually is beneficial to your learning.
cues.zh: 練習把剛學到的事解釋給別人聽，即使不是百分之百確定，實際上也有助於學習。

cues.en: Because if you're never teaching, if you're never explaining and vocalizing and showing what you've learned, you'll always be a beginner.
cues.zh: 因為如果從不教別人、不解釋、不說出並展示自己學到的東西，就會一直停留在初學者階段。

cues.en: This idea of teaching what you learn is a very important concept.
cues.zh: 把學到的東西教給別人，是非常重要的觀念。

cues.en: So moving forward, as you go through the lectures, any time you feel like taking a break, hop on over to Discord and help somebody.
cues.zh: 所以之後看課程時，只要想休息，就去 Discord 幫助別人。

cues.en: Our motto here is that we're always kind.
cues.zh: 我們的座右銘是始終友善。

cues.en: We don't judge anybody.
cues.zh: 不批判任何人。

cues.en: We're all just beginners here.
cues.zh: 在這裡，我們全都是初學者。

cues.en: We're all learning.
cues.zh: 都在學習。

cues.en: So don't be afraid to answer things because you've got to remember nobody's perfect except for Yoda.
cues.zh: 所以別害怕回答問題，記得沒有人是完美的，除了尤達。

cues.en: Yoda is pretty perfect.
cues.zh: 尤達就很完美。

cues.en: All right, I'll see you in the next one.
cues.zh: 好，下一部影片見。

cues.en: Bye bye.
cues.zh: 再見。
